description: This Java class 'VcapServicesStringToConfig' converts a String representing VCAP services into a Typesafe Config object, applying parsing and prefixing operations.

classes.name: VcapServicesStringToConfig
classes.description: Final immutable singleton class implementing Function to convert VCAP JSON string to Typesafe Config object.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Transforms a VCAP services string into a Config object by parsing, prefixing, and appending aliases.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns a new instance of VcapServicesStringToConfig.

methods.name: getPrefixedWithVcap
methods.description: Creates a Config object with the VCAP config path as a key, prefixing the servicesConfig root.
